description: Source code for handling interrupts and triggers for the STMicroelectronics IIS3DHHC accelerometer sensor in Zephyr OS, including interrupt setup, callback handling, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_enable_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the interrupt pin for the sensor.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_trigger_set
methods.description: Links an external trigger to the data ready event.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready interrupt event, calls registered handler.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback function for interrupt pin.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts if configured.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_work_cb
methods.description: Work callback for global thread trigger handling.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO and interrupt configuration for the sensor.
